name: Five Signatures

gist.The Final Trial: The win condition: an Attack that does nothing until she has played all five different Trials this game. Then, as the first Action of a turn, it wins the game outright.
gist.Trial of Loyalty: Fetches up to five different Trials from her deck into her hand. Usually the first one she plays.
gist.Trial of Knowledge: From then on every Trial counts as level zero, so any of her heroes can play the rest.
gist.Trial of Dominance: Defeats and deletes every creature you control. Against a deck with no creatures it is only a tick on her list.
gist.Trial of Annoyance: You discard down to two cards.
gist.Trial of Coolness: Marks one of her other targets: the next time it is defeated it comes straight back at full health.
gist.Beato, the Butterfly Witch: Can play any level-one spell of any school: every Trial, from the first turn. Little health.
gist.Archibald, the Archmage: Double Wisdom: plays Trials without the school by discarding a card for each. Little health.
gist.Tempeste, the Weather Fairy: Every hit on her OTHER heroes is reduced by a fixed amount, so the Storm's zaps and Chain Lightning's lighter bolts do nothing to them while she stands. Hits on Tempeste herself can never be reduced or cancelled.
gist.Homerun!: Cancels a hit that would take out a hero.
gist.Cloud Pillow: Halves what one target takes for a turn.
gist.Smug Coin: Once a game leaves its hero on one health instead of none.
gist.Stoneskin: Attached: its hero takes much less from attacks and cannot be poisoned, burned or stunned.
gist.Holy Cheese: Fetches a Support spell — Trial of Loyalty, usually; you may heal one of your own targets a little in return.
gist.Idol of Crestina: Replaces her draw for the turn with a search for any card: the last missing Trial.

plan: Thandi does not fight. Each Trial may be played once a game and is the only Attack or Spell she plays that turn; five different ones, and then The Final Trial wins on the spot — six turns at the fastest. Loyalty fetches the set, Beato can play all of them, Tempeste takes a fixed bite out of every hit on the other two heroes, and the rest of the deck is shields, pillows and healing. Nothing in it deals damage. Her heroes are frail, the count is public — you always know how many Trials are left — and the Trials are only safe once played: until then they sit in her hand.

looks.early: Trial of Loyalty, and five Trials fanned in her hand; Toughness going onto Beato.
looks.mid: Three Trials played and laid out in a row; Tempeste shrugging off zaps for the others; a Cloud Pillow.
looks.late: Four Trials down, the fifth in hand, The Final Trial next turn.

opening.tell: She plays Trial of Loyalty and shows five different Trials; her heroes have done nothing else.
opening.why: It is a clock, not a board: six turns at the fastest, and nothing she owns can hurt you. Every turn spent holding a sweeper for an empty table is a Trial closer.

midgame.tell: Three Trials lie played in a row; Tempeste soaks up the Storm's zaps for the other two heroes.
midgame.why: The Trials still in her hand are the whole plan: White Eye hits rip them out. Tempeste cannot be shielded by anything, and once she is down every zap counts.

crisis.tell: Four Trials played; she holds the fifth and The Final Trial.
crisis.why: There is nothing to survive: the last card deals no damage, it simply ends the game. Only an empty hand or three fallen heroes stop it.

endgame.tell: The Final Trial is in her discard pile, or she is down to one hero.
endgame.why: Without the last card she has only shields; finish before an Idol of Crestina finds the second copy.
